title: Task Route Layout Density Cleanup

reasons: Fresh desktop/tablet screenshots show the One Time Tasks route using a tall portrait-style hero container that pushes the actual dialogue board below the first screen.
Operations task work should prioritize scanning and repeated action over immersive marketing treatment.
The fix can be scoped to the One Time Tasks route container and CSS without changing task data, filters, APIs, or actions.
affected_product_surfaces: Operations Tasks / Rabbi One Time Dialogue Board
likely_external_provider_blockers: Task mutation, agent execution, helper send, email, WhatsApp, Stripe/payment, access grants, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, and account mutations are out of scope.

operator_intent_summary: Make the Rabbi / One Time Tasks view load in a cleaner, more even way by replacing the oversized scenic task area with a compact operational layout.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

affected_surfaces: Operations Tasks / Rabbi One Time Dialogue Board

known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: The Tasks route first screen is dominated by a tall One Time portrait background panel.
The Rabbi / One Time Dialogue board begins below the first screen on desktop/tablet, forcing scrolling before the operator can scan decisions/tasks.
The right filter panel is visually detached from the dialogue board because the hero area takes the primary canvas.

expanded_phrases.clean: The Tasks route should prioritize readable operational controls and task lanes over decorative hero space.
expanded_phrases.even: The task heading, filters, and dialogue lanes should align in a compact grid across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The first rendered Tasks screen should expose the work board promptly without requiring a long scroll past a scenic background.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The task board remains a first-party BNA Operations workflow scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Make the Rabbi / One Time Tasks route render as a compact operational board instead of an oversized portrait hero.
requirements.expected_result: The task heading, filter/status controls, and Rabbi / One Time Dialogue board are visible high enough in desktop/tablet/mobile screenshots, while task filtering and task actions remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: One Time Tasks route gets a scoped route marker for CSS targeting.
The route-specific One Time dashboard background is compact on the Tasks route and does not use the tall portrait hero treatment.
The dialogue board appears in the first screen on 1440px and 1024px screenshots and remains readable on 390px/430px mobile screenshots.
Task status toolbar, Add Task, Create Decision, Clear filters, and filter controls remain present and unchanged in behavior.
No task workflow, task API, helper action, external write, or action registry behavior changes.

No task workflow or external provider decision is required for local implementation.
